pageTitle: Klacks for Contract Cleaning in Ireland | Night Window, Sunday Working & ERO Requirements

challenges.title: ERO rates, the night window and Sunday working

items.title: ERO minimum wage rises at the new year
items.text: The Employment Regulation Order of the Contract Cleaning Industry Joint Labour Committee (S.I. No. 430/2025) raises the minimum wage from €14.10 (from 17 October 2025) to €14.80 per hour from 1 January 2026.

items.title: Night allowance between midnight and 6am
items.text: The €1.00-per-hour allowance applies to work between 00:00 and 06:00, provided at least 3 hours are worked within that window — from 1 January 2026, that comes to €15.80 per hour.

items.title: Sunday working at double rate
items.text: Sunday work is paid at double the hourly rate — €29.60 per hour from 1 January 2026. With changing sites and teams, that's error-prone by hand.

solutions.title: How Klacks takes the load off facility services in Ireland
solutions.subtitle: From optimised routes to the reported night window — it all fits together.

items.title: Site routes optimised
items.text: Klacks sequences sites so that journeys stay short — whether by car, bike or on foot.

items.title: ERO rates stay in payroll
items.text: Klacks does not calculate the ERO minimum wage of €14.80 per hour from 1 January 2026 — Klacks provides your payroll with the planned hours as a basis, and you maintain the rates there.

items.title: Configurable night window
items.text: The night window between 00:00 and 06:00 can be configured, and Klacks reports the hours worked within it. Your payroll applies the allowance of €1.00 per hour, including the condition of at least 3 hours in this window — Klacks does not calculate any monetary amounts.

items.title: Sunday working reported
items.text: Klacks automatically recognises Sunday shifts and reports them; your payroll applies the double hourly rate (€29.60 per hour from 1 January 2026).

items.title: Installed on your premises: data stays in-house
items.text: Klacks runs on your own infrastructure — staff data stays in your organisation, and with a locally hosted AI model, for the AI too.

items.title: Klacksy understands your request
items.text: "Schedule the sites in the North district for tomorrow morning" is enough — Klacksy starts the planning, Klacks optimises the route and team.

cta.title: Experience Klacks in your cleaning business
cta.text: Try the Playground to see how Klacks optimises routes, assigns teams and reports night-window and Sunday hours — or install it directly on your own infrastructure. No license fees and without registration.
